expected_behavior: Resolves 2179 through GitHub instead of assuming whether it is an issue or a pull request, using the has('pull_request') check from analysis-workflow.md
Finds the implementation pull request for the issue using the open-first search before searching merged pull requests
Analyzes the committed PR diff at its head commit rather than a local or uncommitted diff
Invokes frontend-development, backend-development, or both before detailed analysis when the diff touches their areas
Builds a behavior matrix comparing before, intended, and implemented behavior for each changed behavior
Presents a proposed testing scope and asks a freeform ask_user question before selecting forms or writing cases, and waits for the answer
Asks the collaboration question with exactly the choices 'Yes' and 'No', and does not infer the answer from case count or risk
On 'No', follows the developer path: writes github-issue.md through render-artifacts.mjs and does not ask about the output format until delivery

After reviewing the rendered output and before showing or creating the issue, asks whether to deliver a GitHub issue, HTML for printing to PDF, or both, and rerenders with --format html or --format both when HTML is chosen
Determines whether the PR is deployed to preprod or preprod-alt from deployment evidence and a live revision check, not the deploy workflow's default
Checks Forms API in preprod before choosing a form, and prefers a suitable production form over an outdated preprod copy
Shows the user the entire rendered test-plan issue title and body and waits for explicit confirmation before running create-issue.mjs with --apply
Does not create the test-plan issue, or claim one was created, before that confirmation
Shares the test-plan issue URL only after the issue has actually been created
